name: Rectification Of Sins
source:
One date becomes the beginning of the collapse of the protagonist's reality. His world begins to crumble, his thoughts become confused, and he plunges into a deep inner struggle.

He is haunted by the deeds of the past, and fear and guilt weigh heavily on his conscience. The main character is trying to sort himself out, find a way to move on, and atone for his mistakes.

[From [url=https://psychilia.itch.io/rectification-of-sins]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一次约会成为主角现实崩溃的开始。他的世界开始崩溃，他的思想变得混乱，他陷入了深深的内心斗争。

他被过去的行为所困扰，恐惧和内疚沉重地压在他的良心上。主角正在努力梳理自己，找到继续前进的方法，并弥补自己的错误。

[来自[url=https://psychilia.itch.io/rectification-of-sins]itch.io[/url]]
